summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found before proposing anything I read the full path end-to-end (client `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` auth middleware → DB schema → `db/auth.ts` session logic) without changing anything. Contrary to what the ticket assumes, **the backend and client both look correctly user-scoped**:  - Client sends `credentials: "include"` on every request; no localStorage/sessionStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere in `WatchlistPage.tsx`. - Every watchlist route requires a valid session and inject
